IS 18941 : 2024 Lavanga [Syzygium aromaticum (L.) Merr. & L.M. Perry] Flower Bud for Use in Traditional Medicine - Specification
ICS 11.120.10
ICS 11.120.10
AYD 01
AYD 01
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of test for Lavanga which consists of dried, flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum (L.) Merr. & L.M. Perry, Syn. Eugenia aromatica Kuntze, Eugenia caryophyllata Thunb. (Family Myrtaceae).
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
